_note: Keepsake artifacts (docs/future/12): one-of-a-kind, mysterious trinkets that nets snag later. Models are baked by tools/bake-find-model.mjs into assets/models/keepsakes/ at real size (sizeM is the largest extent in meters, base on y = 0). rotDeg is the turn about x, y, z the game adds when it places one (all zero as baked). observation is the one plain line the journal and the Shelf show; no lore.

artifacts.name: Old bullet
artifacts.observation: A small bullet, green and brown with age. It is smooth where a thumb has held it.

artifacts.name: Carved piece
artifacts.observation: A worn stone post on a wide foot. It leans, just slightly, toward the water.

artifacts.name: Flat relic
artifacts.observation: A flat orange-brown piece, thick at one end. It looks broken off something larger.

artifacts.name: Blue crystal piece
artifacts.observation: A grey stone ball with a pale blue glow in its cracks. It stays cool even in the sun.

artifacts.name: Bronze shoe
artifacts.observation: One small shoe cast in metal, dull and brown. There is no pair.

artifacts.name: Gold disc
artifacts.observation: A round gold piece with a raised rim. It has a pattern on it you cannot quite read.

artifacts.name: Painted jar
artifacts.observation: A small painted jar, empty. The painted animals face away from you.

artifacts.name: Stone trinket
artifacts.observation: A stone shaped by hand, not by water. It fits the palm exactly.

artifacts.name: Little bowl
artifacts.observation: A pale bowl with a clean edge. It was washed by someone a long time ago.
